goal: Make ORIGIN_PRIME computationally active: exact formula-bound verified experience from generation n may reduce repeated discovery work in generation n+1 without gaining verdict authority.

requirements: separator and claimed components are revalidated against the current formula before reuse
verified_separator_route.effect: may bypass repeated exhaustive minimum-separator discovery at the matching root and reuse the already discovered route

requirements: stored assignment is rechecked with satisfies(current_formula, assignment)
sat_witness.effect: may serve as an immediately reverified SAT witness

unsat_memory_only.effect: UNSAT may use structural route memory, but all current boundary/component closure still has to execute unless a separately checkable proof object is introduced in a later frozen contract

required_positive_gates: parent frozen S𓂸ḥ/2 remains executable and unchanged
first K4 SAT traversal is exact and stores verified experience
second exact K4 SAT traversal advances state generation and reuses exact formula-bound experience
second K4 SAT traversal independently rechecks SAT witness against the current formula
first K4 UNSAT traversal is exact and stores verified separator route
second K4 UNSAT traversal revalidates the separator on the current formula and still executes current closure rather than trusting UNSAT memory
reused root route performs strictly less exhaustive root separator-candidate discovery than first traversal
same technical input may preserve POSITION while state commitment changes
formula mismatch does not reuse another formula's experience
negative_controls: attempt to use cached UNSAT as verdict without current closure
forced ORIGIN state reuse instead of advancing generation
